nodes.label: SponsorX Phase 1 — Managed Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 is a managed marketplace: sponsors browse and submit briefs, BTG staff does matching, pricing, conflict checks and invoicing. No self-service checkout — that is Phase 2. Scope, not stack, is the binding constraint (two people vs §31's 4.5–7.5 FTE); cut from the ecommerce end, never from the §39 loop.

nodes.label: Zoho Boundary (Architecture Rule)
nodes.rationale: Zoho knows who we're selling to and whether they've paid; SponsorX knows what was promised, who's delivering it and whether it worked. Keep Zoho, don't build on Zoho; Zoho never touches a request path — all exchanges queued through the worker.

nodes.label: §39 Protected Core Loop
nodes.rationale: athlete application → approval → NIL job/rate → sponsor brief → matching → invitation → Campaign Order → deliverable → tracking/reward → earnings → sponsor report. When scope must give, cut from the self-service ecommerce end, never from this loop.

nodes.label: Always Use Graphify Rule
nodes.rationale: The repo has a persistent knowledge graph in graphify-out/; treat any codebase/architecture/content question as a graphify query before grep/read/manual exploration, falling back to direct file tools only when graphify can't answer. Re-run ingestion after material changes.

nodes.label: Memory Folder Team Sync Rule
nodes.rationale: memory/ is the shared in-repo record other developers update, often daily. Read it at session start; Initial Memory/ is the baseline snapshot, dated subfolders log each day's work. After any task, append to today's dated subfolder; update the baseline only when foundational facts change.

nodes.label: Task Board — Three Artefacts, Three Jobs
nodes.rationale: 345 tasks across four phases. The Markdown phase files own the plan (changed by PR), the consolidated xlsx is the working tracker (changed continuously, gitignored), the Google Sheet is the published status (mirrored by hand once a day — the Drive connector cannot write cells, so it cannot be automated). If a task's definition is wrong, fix the Markdown by PR, never reinterpret it in the tracker.

nodes.label: SponsorX Full Programme Task Board (xlsx)
nodes.rationale: The working tracker, all four phases consolidated; gitignored so each developer keeps a local copy. Inserting a row moves no ranges — Dashboard COUNTIF/COUNTA/SUMIF formulas, autofilter, conditional formatting and Status data validation hardcode the last row and must be extended by hand; use fractional Order values when inserting.

nodes.label: Google Sheet — SponsorXFullProgrammeTaskBoard
nodes.rationale: The published status the team and stakeholders read, updated by hand at end of day. Cannot be automated: the Drive connector is metadata-only for content. Its URL is referenced in ten places; never create a rival copy. Drive xlsx uploads are snapshots, not the tracker (two were renamed ARCHIVE on 2026-09-11).

nodes.label: Phase 1 Open Decisions
nodes.rationale: Do not code around silently: Phase 1 payment policy (§37 gate one, expected earnings-status-only, no tax ID), data residency (since decided US East), guardian e-signature for minors (legal question), transactional email provider, and whether the PDF worker has a real requirement.

nodes.label: Authorization Is Ours
nodes.rationale: Clerk authenticates; tenants, roles and user_roles in Postgres authorize. Every protected record is tenant-scoped (§26), and §30 makes cross-tenant and role tests an acceptance criterion.
